description.en:
Adds goals to the two teams' scores at once, from a 2-element array. It is how the story match scripts award a scripted goal.
Each score is capped at 99. A team whose score is negative (not in use) is left alone.
After a scripted goal the scripts usually log the scorer with CMND_BTL_SET_POINT_HISTORY and restart play from the team that conceded with CMND_BTL_SET_MATCH_RESTART.
[goals to add to team 0, goals to add to team 1].

examples.case: A scripted goal for the opponent team (real usage, from btl0002.nut)
